imports.title: Product import & export
imports.description: Validate a CSV before creating draft Products and SKUs, follow progress, and safely resume interrupted work.
imports.step_template: Download version 1.0 of the template and keep its column names unchanged.
imports.step_upload: Add up to 5,000 rows in a CSV no larger than 5 MB.
imports.step_review: Review every warning and blocking error before starting the import.
imports.file_help: CSV only, up to 5 MB and 5,000 data rows. The browser uploads the file without parsing all rows locally.
imports.cancel_guidance: You may leave this page after starting. The server continues the job, and you can resume from Job history. To stop before starting, choose New upload.
imports.row_valid: Ready to import as a draft
imports.preview_truncated: The preview shows the first 100 rows. The server validates and processes the full file.
imports.partial_explanation: {{valid}} valid rows can be imported as drafts. {{invalid}} invalid rows will be skipped and will never be published.
imports.ready_explanation: All rows passed blocking validation. Warnings remain visible; every Product will still be created as a marketplace-hidden draft.
imports.progress_exact: Processed {{processed}} of {{total}} importable rows. You may leave and return later.
imports.result: {{imported}} rows imported as drafts; {{rejected}} rows rejected. Publication remains a separate reviewed action.
imports.failed_message: Retry to continue after the last committed row. Completed rows will not be created again.
imports.no_store: Create or select a Store before importing Products.
imports.forbidden_message: Your account does not have Product permission for this Store. Ask the Store owner to update your role.
imports.timeout_message: The server may still be working. Refresh Job history before uploading or starting again.
imports.offline_message: Reconnect, then refresh Job history. A running server job is not cancelled when your connection drops.
imports.conflict_title: The request conflicts with saved progress
imports.conflict_message: Refresh the job before retrying. For a corrected file, choose New upload so it receives a new idempotency key.
imports.error_title: Import jobs could not be loaded
imports.error_message: No new import was started. Refresh Job history before trying again.
imports.limit_error: The CSV exceeds the 5 MB or 5,000-row limit. Split it into smaller files and upload each with a new attempt.
imports.template_error: The CSV columns do not match template version 1.0. Download a fresh template and copy your rows into it.
imports.file_error: The CSV could not be read. Choose one valid CSV with the template columns, quoting commas inside cell values.
imports.issue_UNSAFE_SPREADSHEET_FORMULA: This cell begins with a spreadsheet formula marker. Prefix intentional text with an apostrophe.
imports.issue_INVALID_NAME: Name is required and must be 200 characters or fewer.
imports.issue_DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG: Description must be 4,000 characters or fewer.
imports.issue_DESCRIPTION_EMPTY: A description can help buyers understand the product.
imports.issue_INVALID_PRICE: Price must be from 0.01 to 1,000,000 with at most two decimals.
imports.issue_INVALID_STOCK: Stock must be a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000.
imports.issue_ZERO_STOCK: The draft remains unavailable until stock is added.
imports.issue_INVALID_SKU: SKU must use 1–120 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.
imports.issue_DUPLICATE_SKU_IN_FILE: This SKU is repeated in the file.
imports.issue_SKU_ALREADY_EXISTS: This SKU is already in use.
imports.issue_CAPABILITY_MUTATION_LOCKED: Product changes are locked for this Store subscription.
imports.issue_PRODUCT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The Store product limit has been reached.
imports.issue_ROW_REJECTED: The server rejected this row. Correct it and upload a new file.
